    limit)).toNat) (hend : i = (List.drop (backend.seekIdx es kb) es).length ∨ (∃ x, (List.drop
    (backend.seekIdx es kb) es)[i]? = some x ∧ (if eb = [] then decide (x.fst = kb) else decide

    then W64 (2 ^ 63 - 1) else limit)).toNat) : backend.cursorRange es kb eb limit = List.take i

theorem backend.cursorRange_eq (es : List backend.Ent) (kb eb : GoString) (limit : w64) :
    backend.cursorRange es kb eb limit = List.take (sint.Z (if eb = [] then W64 1 else if sint.Z
    limit ≤ 0 then W64 (2 ^ 63 - 1) else limit)).toNat (List.takeWhile (fun e => if eb = [] then
    decide (e.fst = kb) else decide (backend.strLt e.fst eb)) (List.drop (backend.seekIdx es kb)
    es))
